messages:
maria: quick sync — pricing/packaging change is on the ship list for next Tue. need final owners + any blockers for metering, billing adapter, quotas, and contract flags. pls reply with (owner, PR/link, blocker, eta).

kevin: I can own the metering adapter. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/monorepo/pull/1234. blocker: waiting on final plan->quota mapping from product. ETA Thu EOD.

ash: billing team taking billing adapter + ratecard conversion. need sample event schema for usage v2 and clarity on overage flow. @maria can you drop sample mapping?

sanjay: infra: quota-enforcement sidecar is ready but needs the contract-approved soft-limits list. also need canary policy for Dedicated path. can do canary config by monday.

liz-legal: reviewed SLA addendum. two negotiation points: 1) burst credits for enterprise (language needed), 2) retention window for billing logs. will propose contract diffs by Fri.

maria: sample mapping (not final): ```json
{"plan_basic": {"monthly_tokens": 100000, "max_qps": 5}, "plan_pro": {"monthly_tokens": 2000000, "max_qps": 50}}
``` adjust as needed.

kevin: i'll wire that into the PR. q for billing: should we auto-bill overage or cap and surface to sales? meter emits usage events; want to align behaviour. @ash

ash: default behaviour: bill overage + soft-limit notifications. for enterprise deals, enable a per-contract 'cap' option (no auto-charge). implement as contract flag.

maria: ok — @liz-legal pls add wording for cap vs bill + notification cadence (e.g., emails at 80/95%).

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 1901239000 — routing 5% traffic to new pricing path. (reacted :rocket:)

kevin: also pinging @devex for SDK changes — need minor client bump to accept new plan ids and optional 'cap' flag.

devex: got it, will publish patch and release notes. ETA Fri AM.

maria: thanks all. i'll collate owners into a single umbrella ticket and link PRs. cc @ash @kevin @liz-legal @sanjay

kevin: quick follow-up: anyone sees a contract clause that would block soft-limit enforcement?

liz-legal: nothing blocking technically; will flag if sales negotiates bespoke caps.

maria: perfect. i'll drop umbrella ticket after stand.
